user_scope: T0/T1 and conditional T2 only; no T3/RL/API/PPO, no push, no old evidence writes
reference: gB-v1: per-scene native Fixed3 original node order, first legal positive-gain B action; never warm g0 labels
cost: J=L+.75K, full ordered prefix+forced action+Complete_gB followed by frozen complete H; old reachability/coverage/export/scalar checks unchanged

menu.fill_targets: gain to2; gain/(Dcurrent+.75) to4; scarcity=sum1/legalDegree to6; spatial farthest-minimum to8; numeric tie original ID
menu.legal: remaining positive coverage AND finite Dcurrent AND finite Dhome
menu.rule: same-menu gain/(Dcurrent+.75) maximizer, original ID ties

data.prefix_distribution: actual gB trajectory, first state crossing each coverage threshold; duplicate prefixes skipped without replacements
data.split: all different map/task seeds; each map one task draw, balanced modes for dev24/T2_36; T2 not generated or read until T1 passes
data.legacy_labels: T0 analysis only; NO legacy labels enter T1
data.unknown: never zero/negative-filled; every offered T1 menu action fully queried

models.prefix_representation: exact full-prefix state kernel; model receives38 engineered features including prefix edge/order-weighted summaries, NOT a lossless sequence encoder
models.ensemble: linear and MLP each3 seeds, same fit states/features/standardization/minibatch schedule, 1024 updates per seed, batch32states, Adam1e-3, clip1, no dropout/checkpoint selection
models.target: advantage percent=100*(Yref-Y)/Yref; predicted reference score anchored exactly0
models.loss: Huber beta.5 + .25 * true-gap-weighted pairwise softplus temperature.25; ties1e-7 ignored
models.calibration: no fitting: scene maximum absolute advantage error across all calibration menus/actions; order ceil((16+1)*.9)=16, descriptive simultaneous intervals, not a safety theorem
models.choice: largest ensemble mean advantage; original node ties. No extra risk coefficient or dev tuning.

T1_gate.primary: MLP ensemble must meet ALL; linear recorded separately, cannot substitute for failed primary
T1_gate.aggregation: equal-weight independent scenes; equal-weight distinct available prefix states within scene; same unit for means and bootstrap
T1_gate.rule_regret_reduction: scene paired20000 bootstrap95 lower strictly positive
T1_gate.fail: freeze all endpoints/labels/negative results; T2 NOT RUN, no extra epochs/seed/menu variants

T2.model_load: outside request, recorded separately; no neural feature cache reuse
T2.full_request: include C/F/D prep + generating native Fixed3 B for each method needing B + menu/features/inference + construction + H + export/scalar validation; native baselines retain native pipeline
T2.timing: randomized deterministic order seed11522026; deployment compute sum excludes fsync/logging IO, request wall and residual also recorded. Hot cache priming separately counted. No B cache shared across requests.
T2.paired_teacher: new-scene deterministic menu-K8 rollout,4 coverage checkpoints, frozen gB completions and H for each action, teacher offline only. NOT included in student decisions.
T2.mechanism_gate: neural vs gBH mean paired gain>=.5% AND bootstrap95 lower>0; vs same-menu rule bootstrap95 lower>0; all36 valid
T2.compression_gate: new paired teacher mean positive; ratio(sum(gBH-neural)/sum(gBH-teacher))>=1/3, and paired mechanism gate; never divide by old R0 mean
T2.deployment_gate: Detour degradation one-sided95upper<=.5%; complete cold/hot median ratio<=.7 and p95ratio<=1; not dominated in meanJ/median/p95 byFixed3
T2.failure: retain full negative results, no new training or T3

budgets.deadline: T1 starts before first new scene; T2 separate deadline only if gate passes. Cooperative checks between calls/steps and before successful completion, not OS preemption of a running solver. Overrun remains recorded but inconclusive_stop. Failures charged; no replacements.

bootstrap.CI: percentile95 exploratory screen, no multi-seed population-confirmation claim

counters: terminal attempts/completions/failures/native/fullH/internal search/export/scalar, exact cache hits, label uses, scenes/preparations/navhits/hotpriming, gB raw completions/decisions, menu/features, train/inference batches and rows, optimizer updates, elapsed wall separately
